newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU scientific committees to meet on GMO maize.
newsitem.headline: EU scientific committees to meet on GMO maize.

text.p: Three EU scientific committees are due to meet this week to decide how to advise the European Commission on whether to approve the market release of Ciba Geigy's gene-modified maize strain.

Scientific committees on foodstuffs, pesticides and animal nutrition are all due to meet during the next few days in order to advise the Commission in time for Commissioners' discussions at next week's regular meeting on November 13, an official told Reuters.
Debate centres on a proposal, originally submitted by France, to authorise the marketing of a genetically modified corn strain owned by the Swiss chemical company.
Environment ministers reached no decision on the file in June, passing it back to Environment Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard.
The Dane said in July statement IP/96/708/EEC that "widespread political and public concerns" raised in relation to the proposal had prompted her decision to seek further advice.
